cpu: 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13700K (24 threads, AVX2, no AVX-512)
storage: single NVMe partition holding models, pack and MTP
pcie_topology: four cards behind PCIe switch branches of one root complex; lspci's LnkSta on the card reports an internal port (x1 2.5GT/s), not the data path (the engine's own copy test measures 26.7 GB/s; see README)
